en.headline: Civil service appraisal overhaul begins for 100 grades
en.dek: The Civil Service Bureau said the first phase covers 100 grades in appraisal cycles starting on or after 1 October, with a review after two cycles.
body: The first phase of an overhaul of the civil service appraisal system is under way for 100 grades, Secretary for the Civil Service Ingrid Yeung said on Friday, according to RTHK.

Yeung said the phase applies to appraisal cycles that began on or after 1 October 2026. The bureau will review the scheme after two appraisal cycles, and she expected it could be extended to more grades over the next five years.

She told lawmakers that strengthening governance and the civil service management system remained a priority of the current term, including the accountability system for heads of department. She said a two-tier investigation mechanism for administrative accountability was also being put in place.

Yeung said a simplified mechanism for retiring officers with persistently poor performance had been in use since September 2023, and that departments had become more willing to use it. She said the bureau would keep monitoring how departments follow up.

zh.headline: 公務員評核優化首期涵蓋100個職階
zh.dek: 公務員事務局表示，評核制度優化計劃第一期涵蓋100個職階，適用於10月1日或之後開始的評核周期，兩個周期後檢討。
body: 港台引述公務員事務局局長楊何蓓茵周五表示，公務員評核制度優化計劃第一期會在100個職階實施。
楊何蓓茵說，計劃適用於2026年10月1日或之後開始的評核周期。局方會在完成兩個評核周期後檢討成效，預計未來五年可以推展到更多職階。
她在立法會表示，強化治理和完善公務員管理制度是本屆政府施政重點，包括落實部門首長責任制，並會做好行政責任兩級調查機制下第二級調查的系統和人員安排。
她又說，政府已在2023年9月推行經簡化的機制，處理工作表現持續欠佳的公務員。簡化後部門更願意使用該機制，當局會持續監察跟進情況。
